propositions: pipx source install fails when host uv is older than 0.9.17
error reports 'pipx needs uv>=0.9.17' despite being a host toolchain mismatch not a rebar packaging defect
pipx install --backend pip can bypass the failure by using pip instead of uv as the backend
the workaround applies to local-path pipx installs from source
pipx 1.16.5 and later expose --backend {pip,uv} option to select package backend
